description: Curated text prompt library for the generative text-to-motion catalog. Each entry is generated through POST /api/forge-motion (the self-hosted GCP text2motion worker), quality-gated, then published to the R2 prefix animations/library/generated/ and surfaced by GET /api/animations/library alongside the Mixamo-sourced clips. Categories mirror the browse facets on /animations so a generated clip lands in the same taxonomy a curated one does.
